decisions.mana_note: scalars[0]*10 is spendable mana, not raw native mana; older captures reconstruct raw as spendable+reserved.

native.timing_note: Native 20Hz; mana is held from the left sample for intervals <=5 ticks. Invalid frames/world changes/large gaps split coverage. This is sampled time, not exact continuous mana.

timings.input_boundary: ADB target tap process returned, not measured touch processing time
timings.ack_boundary: First sampled native own-hand rotation, not exact troop appearance
timings.image_boundary: PNG received on Mac; capture exposure and display lag unknown
timings.model_input: Native memory snapshot; screenshots are diagnostic only

limitations: No new games or Android connections.
Native hand ACK does not prove body location, spell impact or successful defence.
Unconfirmed and unresolved commands are separate from ACKs; no result/win rate is inferred.
Per-card legal/selection counts use recorded masks, not changed-policy rollouts.
The readiness guard replay only identifies deferred original commands, not their counterfactual outcomes.
Frames and decisions from a single match are correlated, not independent quality trials.

series.scope: Only matches belonging to this explicitly authorized finite series

user_stop.reason: User: все стоп; continue development, no further matches
user_stop.scope: offline development only; no queue or gameplay input

exact_replay.limitation: Decision agreement is not tactical quality or evidence of successful placement.
